newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq closes within range of record close.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq closes within range of record close.

text.p: The Nasdaq Composite closed within a stone's throw of its all time high, triggered by a rally in the bond market following release of a much weaker than forecast September payroll report.

The Nasdaq Composite Index was up 14.47 points, or 1.17 percent, at 1247.56 at its unofficial close. Advances led declining issues by 2242 to 1843 on volume of about 572 million shares. The record was set on June 5, when the Composite closed at 1249.15.

Friday's rally had rising-tide-lifts-all-boats, or most boats anyway, effect with Intel Corp up 2-3/16 at 101-11/16, Sun Microsystems Inc up 2-3/4 at 64-3/8 Cisco Systems Inc up 2-3/8 at 67, U.S. Robotics Corp up 3-3/8 at 73
Among special situations, Kinder-Care Learnings Centers Inc was up 3-1/2 at 19-3/4 after agreeing to a $600 million buyout deal lead by Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co.
Davox Corp was up 2-3/8 at 39-5/8 after Oppenheimer & Co initiated coverage of the stock with an outperform rating.
